TEXT:
[FI] Akihabara is especially bustling during summer 
holidays.

[FI] There's a child showing interest in otaku goods 
stores-
[FI] And a father quietly educating him-
[FI] Seeing this scenario unfold, I let out a wry smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hey! Kyousuke-shi!
[FI] I heard a familiar voice from afar.

[FI] When I looked back, I saw Saori approaching me 
while waving her hand, donning the "uniform" of 
the area.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] My pardons for being late. My preparations took 
longer than anticipated.
[FI] -It's been a while, indeed.

[FI] Is what I almost blurted out, but Saori and 
Bajeena are one and the same.

[FI] So I decided to speak to her, in a tone as if you 
were complimenting someone appearing different 
from usual.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So you're Bajeena today.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Yes! That's because today's date will unfold in this 
stage that's Akiba!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Or...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Could it be that you aren't pleased with dating this 
side of me in particular?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nah, nothing like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This version of you suits me well too.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Mufu~ ＠ω＠

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Now! Let us depart at once, Kyousuke-shi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey!

[FI] Check out how positive she is. Such a huge 
difference.

[FI] I can't picture that shy lady and this person are the 
very same.
[FI] She's even getting me worked up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Woah! Over here, Kyousuke-shi!

[FI] Saori was immediately fixated over this plastic 
model showcase.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That red robot is really flashy.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] This is the dream mobile suit the Major piloted in 
the light novel♪

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Even this has materialized into 3D... 
fu[font_size=26]fu[/font_size][font_size=18]fu[/font_size]fu, splendid.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Huh... Is this something only rabid fans can 
appreciate?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] This item can only exist through the fruits of labor 
of a fan.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] This is naturally making my mouth bigger and my 
wallet smaller!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Now, onto the next store!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I got it, I got it. Don't pull.
[FI] Saori sure is acting like a kid today.
